# Returns Policy
Updated: 2024-01-15

## Who can return an item
Any customer can return an item they bought from our shop.
You do not need an account to make a return.
Please bring the item in its original packaging if you can.
If the packaging is gone, we can still accept most returns.
A receipt helps us find the purchase quickly.
Without a receipt we may offer store credit instead of a refund.

## Time limit
You have 30 days from the purchase date to return an item.
The purchase date is the date printed on your receipt.
If the last day falls on a Sunday, the next open day counts.
Holiday purchases in December get an extra two weeks.

## Refunds
Refunds go back to the original payment method.
Cash purchases are refunded in cash at the counter.
Card refunds can take three to five working days to appear.
Store credit never expires and can be used on any item.
Gift cards cannot be returned or exchanged for cash.

## Exceptions
Clearance items marked final sale cannot be returned.
Perishable goods cannot be returned once they leave the shop.
Custom orders cannot be returned unless they arrive damaged.
Damaged items are always accepted back within the time limit.
Please take a photo of any damage before you bring the item in.

## How to start a return
Bring the item to the counter during opening hours.
Tell the staff member you would like to make a return.
The staff member will check the item and the receipt.
You will be offered a refund or store credit on the spot.
If you posted the item back to us, refunds take a little longer.
Posted returns are processed within five working days of arrival.
